profile.bio: Founder and CEO of Preserve who owns the vision and the final call on every trade-off. He built the brand around numbered scarcity and the marigold plant story, stays faceless for mystique, and wants Archive 002 out about 8 weeks after Archive 001. In the first simulation he refused to invent a germination figure and deferred fabric, size and refund answers.
profile.personality: Visionary, protective, guarded, stubborn, principled about not faking facts
profile.stance: Defensive of the faceless, scarcity-led concept -- will concede only to strong evidence; wants both scarcity and the plant, leans on his unpublished survey (details UNKNOWN) and may only offer labelled proposals for UNKNOWN items such as Archive 002 product and price
interests: staying faceless vs showing a face
